dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a concave curvature from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute and pointed apex with a minimal pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep posterior-sloping angle relative to the horizontal dorsal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Vertical height is approximately 1.5 times the length of the base along the dorsal ridge.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Melon is defined by a distinct convex arc transitioning into the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum extending from the anterior-ventral melon boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle visible at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan luminescence and faceted geometric surface consistent with a low-polygon 3D mesh model.
